Session date: 4:06 pm on 23 January, 2023
[D1:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, nice to meet you! How's your week going? Anything fun happened?
[D1:2] Jolene: Hi Deb! Good to meet you! Yeah, my week's been busy. I finished an electrical engineering project last week - took a lot of work, but it's done now. Anything fun happening for you?
[D1:3] Deborah: Congrats! Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.
[D1:4] Jolene: Why does it hold such special memories for you?
[D1:5] Deborah: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.
[D1:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman in a wheelchair hugging a woman in a wheelchair
[D1:6] Jolene: Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember?
[D1:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a bench and a window
[D1:7] Deborah: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.
[D1:8] Jolene: Staying connected is super important. Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010  in Paris.
[D1:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a heart shaped pendant with a bird on it
[D1:9] Deborah: Yes, I also have a pendant that reminds me of my mother. And what is special for you about your jewelry?
[D1:10] Jolene: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.
[D1:11] Deborah: It should really give you strength and energy!
[D1:12] Jolene: Do you have goals?
[D1:13] Deborah: One of my goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting my community. I'm passionate about helping people find peace and joy through it.
[D1:14] Jolene: What inspired you to go down this route?
[D1:15] Deborah: Yoga helped me find peace during a rough time, and now I'm passionate about sharing that with others.
[D1:16] Jolene: It is truly inspiring!
[D1:17] Deborah: Gotta run, bye!
[D1:18] Jolene: Looking forward to the next chat!
Session date: 9:49 am on 27 January, 2023
[D2:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, sorry to tell you this but my dad passed away two days ago. It's been really tough on us all - his sudden death left us all kinda shell-shocked. I'm trying to channel my grief by spending more time with family and cherishing the memories. These moments remind me to live life fully.
[D2:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman hugging a woman who is sitting on a couch
[D2:2] Jolene: Sorry to hear about your dad, Deborah. Losing a parent is tough - how's it going for you and your family?
[D2:3] Deborah: Even though it's hard, it's comforting to look back on the great memories. We looked at the family album. Photos give me peace during difficult times. This is my parents' wedding in 1993.
[D2:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bride and groom posing for a picture
[D2:4] Jolene: They were a beautiful couple!
[D2:5] Deborah: My husband and I are trying to be as good a family as my parents were!
[D2:6] Jolene: What do you value in your relationship?
[D2:7] Deborah: It is love, and openness that have kept us close all these years. Being there for each other has made us both happy. Look what letter I received yesterday!
[D2:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a note written to someone on a piece of paper
[D2:8] Jolene: What touching words! Who is this letter from?
[D2:9] Deborah: The group members sent this to me! They thanked me for the positive influence I had on them. Those moments remind me why I'm so passionate about yoga.
[D2:10] Jolene: Where do you most often do yoga?
[D2:11] Deborah: This is one of the places where I do it.
[D2:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a living room with a television and a window
[D2:12] Jolene: Where is it?
[D2:13] Deborah: That's my old home. I go there now and then for my mom, who passed away. Sitting in that spot by the window gives me peace.
[D2:14] Jolene: Must be great to have that place where you feel connected to her.
[D2:15] Deborah: Yeah, it's special. I can feel her presence when I sit there and it comforts me.
[D2:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a window seat in a room with a window
[D2:16] Jolene: Wow, it sounds like that spot holds a lot of sentimental value. Does it bring back any special memories?
[D2:17] Deborah: Yeah, Jolene. She'd sit there every night with a book and a smile, reading was one of her hobbies. It was one of her favorite places in the house. 
[D2:17] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a view of the sky from an airplane window
[D2:18] Jolene: What other hobbies did your mother have?
[D2:19] Deborah: Travel was also her great passion!
[D2:20] Jolene: I want to show you one of my snakes! They always calm me down and make me happy. This is Susie.
[D2:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bed with a snake head sticking out of it
[D2:21] Deborah: Having a pet totally brightens up your life. It's great that it brings you comfort. Do you have any fun moments with your pet that you'd like to share?
[D2:22] Jolene:  I was playing video games and my pet just slinked out of her cage and coiled up next to me - it was too funny! My second snake Seraphim did it. Look at her sly eyes!
[D2:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake sticking its head out of a blanket
[D2:23] Deborah: Awww, that's so nice! 
[D2:24] Jolene: I bought it a year ago in Paris.
[D2:25] Deborah: Cool, Jolene! Pets bring so much happiness!
[D2:26] Jolene: They are very unusual pets! Here's me and my partner gaming last week - it's so fun. We played the game "Detroit" on the console. We are both crazy about this activity!
[D2:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person laying in bed with a dog watching tv
[D2:27] Deborah: Did your boyfriend teach you to play?
[D2:28] Jolene: Even as a child I learned to play on my own.
[D2:29] Deborah: Do you only play old games or try new ones?
[D2:30] Jolene: We are planning to play "Walking Dead" next Saturday.
[D2:31] Deborah: Take care and keep spreading those good vibes!
[D2:32] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! You too, take care. See ya!
Session date: 7:03 pm on 1 February, 2023
[D3:1] Jolene: Hi Deb! How're you? I've been busy. My engineering professor gave us a huge robotics project. It's tough but fun, it's making me get creative and problem-solve.
[D3:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a table with a robot on it and a laptop
[D3:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! It's great to hear from you. It sounds challenging but interesting! It must be really putting your creative and problem-solving skills to the test. How did you feel when you first received the project? Are you enjoying working on it?
[D3:3] Jolene: When I got it, I felt a mix of emotions - excited and nervous. But now, I'm really enjoying it! It's like trying to solve a puzzle, figuring out the best design and programming. Seeing the robot come together is awesome too!

Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Good to hear from you. How've you been? I've been on an emotional rollercoaster lately, but I'm coping.
[D4:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. All good here - how about you? Anything new happening lately?
[D4:3] Jolene: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.
[D4:4] Deborah: That's awesome. You must have worked really hard for that. I'm so proud of you. Care to share more about it?
[D4:5] Jolene: Thanks so much! I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. It was tough, but I loved the experience.
[D4:6] Deborah: Your engineering skills really made a difference for people in a rural area. That's amazing! How did it feel when you saw it working?
[D4:7] Jolene: It was such a surreal moment. Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying. It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives. It made me feel like I had a purpose and had done something good.
[D4:8] Deborah: So, what are your career aspirations now?
[D4:9] Jolene:  I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions. My goal is to contribute towards making the world a better place with my work.
[D4:10] Deborah:  I'm sure great things will keep coming your way. Keep up the good work and follow your passions!
[D4:11] Jolene: Your support means a lot. I'm determined to keep going and make a difference. Your encouragement really motivates me to pursue my passions.
[D4:12] Deborah: When things get tough, just take a deep breath and remember why you're doing this. This is where I spend a lot of my time, teaching yoga. It's a great way to find balance and reconnect with ourselves. I bonded with Anna during yesterday's l yoga class.
[D4:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women in a dance studio doing a dance pose
[D4:13] Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! What new poses did you try?
[D4:14] Deborah: We were trying out different dance poses, like Warrior II, which builds strength and boosts focus.
[D4:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair
[D4:15] Jolene: Is it difficult to do?
[D4:16] Deborah: Yes, but this brought us closer to Anna! We supported each other, that means a lot.
[D4:17] Jolene: Can you explain how to do it?
[D4:18] Deborah: Sure! To do this modified pose, sit on the edge of a chair with your feet planted. Twist your torso to one side and use your hand on your knee for support. You'll feel a stretch in your back and shoulders as you hold it for a few breaths, then switch sides. It's great for relaxing tense muscles.
[D4:19] Jolene: Sounds really hard! Here's my bookshelf!
[D4:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book shelf with a lot of books on it
[D4:20] Deborah: That's quite a collection! Have you had a favorite book lately? I'd love to hear your thoughts.
[D4:21] Jolene: Thanks Deborah! I'm really into this book called "Sapiens" - it's a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us. It's giving me a lot to think about!
[D4:22] Deborah: Great, this is interesting! Have you come across any recent ones that really struck you?
[D4:23] Jolene: Two weeks ago I read "Avalanche" by Neal Stephenson in one sitting! 
[D4:24] Deborah: That sounds cool, Jolene. Stories can be so powerful - they can teach us, motivate us, and bring us together. 
[D4:25] Jolene: I also read a recent story about someone who became successful despite facing numerous challenges. It really showed me that anything is possible if you believe and work hard.
[D4:26] Deborah: That's a really powerful message. It reminds me of someone special and their grace and strength when they faced hardships. Check out this creation!
[D4:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bouquet of flowers in a vase on a table
[D4:27] Jolene: Wow, Deb! That's beautiful! Can you tell me the backstory of that bouquet?
[D4:28] Deborah: My friend gave me this bouquet when I was struggling, and it gives me hope and courage. I'm filled with warmth and appreciation when I look at it.
[D4:29] Jolene: That's really sweet. Such a small thing can make a real difference.
[D4:30] Deborah: It's amazing how something as simple as flowers can make a real difference. Nature sure is beautiful.
[D4:31] Jolene: Where are some of your favorite nature spots?
[D4:32] Deborah: Oh, there's so many great places! My favorite is a park with a forest trail - it's so calming getting lost in nature. Then there's this beach nearby that I love - the sound of the waves and the sand under my feet make me feel all peaceful and happy. Do you have any favorite spots, Jolene?
[D4:33] Jolene: Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power.
[D4:33] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D4:34] Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.
[D4:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water
[D4:35] Jolene: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?
[D4:36] Deborah: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.
[D4:36] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman wearing a white shirt and a gold chain necklace
[D4:37] Jolene: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?
[D4:38] Deborah: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.
[D4:39] Jolene: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.
[D4:40] Deborah: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.
[D4:41] Jolene: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.

[D18:14] Deborah: We're in this together. Give me a shout if you need anything. Bye for now.

Session date: 12:52 am on 19 August, 2023
[D19:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Hope you're having a good one. Last Friday I told Anna the story of my life and they were super kind about it. It was so nice to have a meaningful connection. How's the mindfulness workshops and reading going? Need any help?

[D19:6] Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! Gonna make a plan to manage my studies and hobbies. Say, do you ever play video games?
[D19:7] Deborah: I used to play some video games, but it's been a while. It's a good way to relax after a busy day. Do you have any game suggestions? What's your favorite game?

Session date: 3:56 pm on 6 June, 2023
[D13:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Long time no talk - I had lots of stuff going on. Remember the tough engineering project? I finally wrapped that up last month. Look at the result!
[D13:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a solar powered vehicle with a solar panel on the back
[D13:2] Deborah: Jolene! Congrats on wrapping up your with it! You really put in the work and it paid off. 
[D13:3] Jolene:  I'm really proud of myself for sticking it out despite the problems and finishing it. It's definitely a big milestone.

[D13:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of construction workers posing for a picture
[D13:6] Deborah: What's been the best part of it so far?

[D13:8] Deborah: Mind if I ask how the internship has impacted you?
[D13:9] Jolene: It has had a positive impact on my life. It has stoked my love of engineering and has encouraged me to keep striving for my dreams.
[D13:10] Deborah:  How has it inspired you to keep striving for your dreams?
[D13:11] Jolene: Hanging out with people who love what they do has really inspired me to stay focused and keep working towards my goals. It's shown me that with dedication and effort, anything is possible.
[D13:12] Deborah: Have you been able to find a good work-life balance during your internship?

[D13:14] Deborah:  Have you considered taking some breaks and finding activities like yoga to help you relax and unwind? That might make a difference.
[D13:15] Jolene: Yeah, I`m trying to do it. Here's an example of how I spent yesterday morning, yoga on top of mount Talkeetna.
[D13:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man standing on a rock with his arms outstretched
[D13:16] Deborah: Nice job, Jolene! How long have you been doing yoga and meditation? It looks like it's really helping you regroup and recharge.

[D13:18] Deborah: Has it benefited you in any way? Have you found it helpful in difficult moments?

[D13:20] Deborah: Glad they've been helpful for you!
[D13:21] Jolene: No idea how I would've survived without them!
[D13:22] Deborah: This is my favorite studio and it's always so calming. 
[D13:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a bench and a window

[D13:25] Jolene: Thanks, Deborah! I'll definitely give it a try. Appreciate the advice!
[D13:26] Deborah:  If you need more tips or help, just let me know. Take care!
[D13:27] Jolene: See you!

Session date: 3:09 pm on 15 September, 2023
[D28:5] Deborah: Wow, it was so special. A glimpse into her life beyond what I knew. Through their eyes, I appreciate her more. Here I am and my mom.
[D28:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women in pajamas taking a selfie in a mirror
[D28:6] Jolene: That looks like a blast! What did you and your mom's friends do on that day?
[D28:7] Deborah: We reminisced and looked through her photos. It was really sweet.
[D28:8] Jolene: Looking at old photos must have been so nostalgic! It's great that you could share that experience with friends. It's amazing how photos and memories can give us a deeper appreciation for the people we love.
[D28:9] Deborah: Pictures really have a way of bringing back memories and making us appreciate the special bond we have with our loved ones. They remind me of how strong love is and how amazing human relationships can be. Just like this one.
[D28:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D28:10] Jolene: Wow, what a gorgeous pic! Do you have any special memories of that beach or just love surfing in general?
[D28:11] Deborah: That beach is super special to me. It's where I got married and discovered my love for surfing. It's always filled with joy and peace.
[D28:12] Jolene: What pleasant memories.
[D28:13] Deborah: Here is another photo from my classes.
[D28:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach
[D28:14] Jolene: Wow, that yoga pose looks amazing! Does it help you relax?
[D28:15] Deborah: Oh yeah! Doing this on the beach is so peaceful - the ocean, sand, and fresh air create a super relaxing atmosphere. The perfect way to take care of myself.
[D28:16] Jolene:  I like to create my own serene yoga space with candles and oils for extra chill vibes. Also, we tried a new style of meditation in Thailand - with flowers.
[D28:16] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a couple of towels sitting on top of a table
[D28:17] Deborah: Oh, same for me!
[D28:18] Jolene: I find calm when I do yoga or meditate. I use essential oils and put on some soft, soothing music in the background to create a peaceful atmosphere. It really helps me chill out and center myself.
[D28:19] Deborah:  It's amazing how our environment can enhance our practice.
[D28:20] Jolene: Yeah, totally! Our surroundings can really affect our mood and how much zen we can get from our routine. Creating a place that feels safe and chill is key.
[D28:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bed with a colorful blanket and pillows
[D28:21] Deborah: Wow, that looks so comfy and inviting! Where do you usually go to relax in your house?
[D28:22] Jolene: In my room, I usually go to relax and feel at ease. After a busy day, it's my little haven for peace and rest - the perfect spot to relax and recharge.
[D28:23] Deborah: Sounds like your room does the job. That's awesome.
[D28:24] Jolene:  Here are my pals keeping me company.
[D28:24] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a snake in a container
[D28:25] Deborah: Hey, that's Susie or Seraphim? How long has he been hanging out with you?
[D28:26] Jolene: It`s Susie! I've had her for two years now. 
[D28:27] Deborah: It's awesome how pets can bring us comfort and peace when we need it.
[D28:28] Jolene: Susie is a great companion.
[D28:29] Deborah: The love pets give is priceless.
[D28:30] Jolene: Plus, they make life a lot brighter!
Session date: 1:24 pm on 17 September, 2023
[D29:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, I'm so excited to tell you! Yesterday, me and my neighbor ran a free gardening class for the community, it was awesome! People of any age joined in and it was such a great thing to see.
[D29:2] Jolene: Wow, Deborah, that's awesome! Keep up the great work, and here's hoping for more events like this in the future!
[D29:3] Deborah:  Gardening is really amazing. It brings us together in such a cool way. It was awesome to share my love of plants and help people take care of the world. So, what about you? Anything new happened lately?
[D29:4] Jolene: We tried a scuba diving lesson last Friday and had an awesome time! We found a cool dive spot we can explore together. Trying new things opens up a world of adventure - maybe one day I'll be a certified diver. Anything fun going on with you?
[D29:5] Deborah: That sounds amazing, Jolene! I've been interested in underwater life, but I haven't had the chance to try scuba diving yet. Recently, I've been spending time remembering my mom. Last Sunday, I visited her old house and sat on a bench. It was a comforting experience, as if I could feel her presence guide me and remind me of her love.
[D29:6] Jolene: Visiting your mom's old home sounds like it was really special. Is there something special you remember about her?
[D29:7] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! It was really special. My mom had a big passion for cooking. She would make amazing meals for us, each one full of love and warmth. I can still remember the smell of her special dish, it would fill the house and bring us all together.
[D29:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bowl of food with a spoon in it
[D29:8] Jolene: Mmm, that looks delicious, Deb! So sweet how cooking with your mom brought everyone together. What's your best memory of cooking with her?
[D29:9] Deborah: I loved it when she would bake pineapple birthday cakes for me when I was a kid. It always made me feel so special.
[D29:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pineapple cake with a smiley face on it
[D29:10] Jolene: No wonder it made you feel special. 
[D29:11] Deborah: Have you ever had something like that with someone close?
[D29:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a mixer with a whisk in it
[D29:12] Jolene: I used to bake cookies with someone close to me.
[D29:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of four chocolate chip cookies on a baking sheet
[D29:13] Deborah: What's your favorite cookie to make?
[D29:14] Jolene: The warm, gooey chocolate and soft, buttery cookie are a match made in heaven.
[D29:15] Deborah: I really want to eat this now.
[D29:16] Jolene: Well look what I have here!
[D29:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a book open on a bed
[D29:17] Deborah:  Is there anything special about it or the photo?
[D29:18] Jolene: It takes me to another world when I read it!
[D29:19] Deborah: Did I show you that I have a big bookshelf too?
[D29:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a living room with a couch and a book shelf
[D29:20] Jolene: I think not, I really like it!
[D29:21] Deborah: Having a space like this is important for escaping reality and relaxing with a book. Do you have any books that really moved you?
[D29:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bathroom with a black and white wall and a wooden stool
[D29:22] Jolene: My bathroom has an aesthetic vibe. Once I read a self-discovery book there and it really resonated with me.
[D29:23] Deborah: Wow! A special book that speaks to you and helps with self-discovery? That's awesome. Plus, having a cozy nook to chill? That's my best one!
[D29:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D29:24] Jolene: Sounds nice, Deb! A cozy nook is a must! The beach is a great place for finding peace and relaxation. Have you ever tried surfing?
